name: Camping Maurerhäusl
beschreibung: The campsite Maurerhäusl is located in Hochfilzen, a municipality in the Pillerseetal in Tirol. The surroundings are characterised by extensive forests and the nearby mountain range of the Loferer Steinberge. The site offers pitches for motorhomes and caravans as well as tent options. The sanitary facilities are equipped with modern showers and washrooms. A small grocery store supplies guests with basic foodstuffs. From here, the Biathlonarena Hochfilzen and several hiking trails are easily accessible. Cross-country skiing trails also start directly at the campsite.
